question.problem:
$$
{f}_{X|Y}(x\,|\,-1)=\{\begin{aligned}\frac{24}{7{x}^{4}}, & \,1\le x\le 2 \\ 0, & \,\text{otherwise}\end{aligned}
$$

Let $X$ and $Y$ be continuous random variables. 
Find the conditional variance $\text{Var}[X\,|\,Y=-1]$ given that the conditional probability density function ${f}_{X|Y}(x\,|\,-1)$ is shown above and the corresponding expected value is ${\mu }_{X|-1}=\frac{9}{7}.$
question.worked_solution:
Recall that the conditional variance of $X$ given $Y=y$ is defined by

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{Var}[X\,|\,Y=y] & =\text{E}[(X-{\mu }_{X|y})^{2}\,|\,Y=y] \\  & =\text{E}[{X}^{2}\,|\,Y=y]-{\mu }_{X|y}^{2},\end{aligned}
$$

where 

$$
\text{E}[{X}^{2}\,|\,Y=y]={\int }_{-\infty }^{\infty }{x}^{2}\,{f}_{X|Y}(x\,|\,y)\,\text{d}x.
$$

Therefore, we obtain 

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{E}[{X}^{2}\,|\,Y=-1] & ={\int }_{-\infty }^{\infty }{x}^{2}\,{f}_{X|Y}(x\,|\,-1)\,\text{d}x \\  & ={\int }_{1}^{2}{x}^{2}\cdot \frac{24}{7{x}^{4}}\,\text{d}x \\  & ={\int }_{1}^{2}\frac{24}{7{x}^{2}}\,\text{d}x \\  & =\frac{24}{7}{[-\frac{1}{x}]}_{1}^{2} \\  & =\frac{24}{7}[(-\frac{1}{2})-(-1)] \\  & =\frac{12}{7}\end{aligned}
$$

Finally,

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{Var}[X\,|\,Y=-1] & =\text{E}[{X}^{2}\,|\,Y=-1]-{\mu }_{X|-1}^{2} \\  & =\frac{12}{7}-{(\frac{9}{7})}^{2} \\  & =\frac{12}{7}-\frac{81}{49} \\  & =\frac{3}{49}.\end{aligned}
$$
